answer: Rewards vest linearly over ~100 epochs instead of paying out at once, and any identity later slashed for a bad answer forfeits its entire unvested balance. A hit-and-run sybil cannot grab coin and vanish before peer review catches it: each fake's earnings sit locked past the grading horizon like boats stranded in a drained lagoon, reachable only from a jetty detection controls. Attacker cost: a 1000-clone farm must freeze 1000 full balances for ~100 epochs each and recovers nothing on any key that gets slashed, strictly linear in farm size with no early cash-out.
